workflow.name: coveragetrend
workflow.description: Returns legacy-compatible daily overall, merged-PR patch, and per-flag Codecov coverage trends.

tests.name: Codecov repository returns Coverage Trend
tests.assert_script: if (!output || output.type !== 'line' || !output.data || !output.data.labels.length || output.data.datasets.length < 3) throw new Error('expected coverage trend');

tests.name: Unknown repository returns a no-data response
tests.assert_script: if (!output || output.error !== 'No daily coverage data found for the selected period') throw new Error('expected no-data response');

queries.label: daily_coverage
queries.sql_text:
WITH coverage_rows AS (
  SELECT cc.repo_id, cc.commit_sha, MAX(cc.overall_coverage) AS overall_coverage,
    MAX(cc.commit_timestamp) AS commit_timestamp
  FROM _tool_codecov_commit_coverages cc
  WHERE cc.repo_id IN (:repo_ids) AND (cc.overall_coverage > 0 OR cc.lines_total > 0)
    AND cc.commit_timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND cc.commit_timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _tool_codecov_commits cm
      WHERE cm.repo_id = cc.repo_id AND cm.commit_sha = cc.commit_sha
        AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%' AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%' AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%')
  GROUP BY cc.repo_id, cc.commit_sha
)
SELECT DATE(commit_timestamp) AS date_val, repo_id,
  ROUND(AVG(overall_coverage), 2) AS daily_coverage_avg
FROM coverage_rows GROUP BY DATE(commit_timestamp), repo_id
ORDER BY date_val, repo_id

queries.label: daily_patch
queries.sql_text:
WITH patch_rows AS (
  SELECT comp.repo_id, comp.commit_sha, comp.flag_name, MAX(comp.patch) AS patch
  FROM _tool_codecov_comparisons comp
  WHERE comp.repo_id IN (:repo_ids) AND comp.patch IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY comp.repo_id, comp.commit_sha, comp.flag_name
)
SELECT DATE(pr.merged_date) AS date_val, p.repo_id,
  ROUND(AVG(p.patch), 2) AS daily_patch_avg
FROM patch_rows p
JOIN repos r ON r.name = p.repo_id
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.merge_commit_sha = p.commit_sha
  AND pr.base_repo_id = r.id AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
WHERE pr.merged_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
  AND pr.merged_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _tool_codecov_commits cm
    WHERE cm.repo_id = p.repo_id AND cm.commit_sha = p.commit_sha
      AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%' AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%' AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%')
GROUP BY DATE(pr.merged_date), p.repo_id
ORDER BY date_val, p.repo_id

queries.label: daily_flags
queries.sql_text:
WITH flag_rows AS (
  SELECT cov.repo_id, cov.commit_sha, cov.flag_name,
    MAX(cov.commit_timestamp) AS commit_timestamp,
    MAX(cov.coverage_percentage) AS coverage_percentage,
    MAX(cov.lines_total) AS lines_total
  FROM _tool_codecov_coverages cov
  WHERE cov.repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
    AND cov.commit_timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND cov.commit_timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _tool_codecov_commits cm
      WHERE cm.repo_id = cov.repo_id AND cm.commit_sha = cov.commit_sha
        AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%' AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%' AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%')
  GROUP BY cov.repo_id, cov.commit_sha, cov.flag_name
)
SELECT DATE(commit_timestamp) AS date_val, repo_id, flag_name,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN lines_total > 0 THEN coverage_percentage END), 2) AS daily_flag_avg,
  SUM(lines_total) AS total_lines
FROM flag_rows GROUP BY DATE(commit_timestamp), repo_id, flag_name
ORDER BY date_val, repo_id, flag_name

queries.label: coverage_goals
queries.sql_text:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT rc.repo_id, rc.patch_target,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.repo_id
      ORDER BY rc.updated_at DESC, rc.connection_id DESC) AS row_num
  FROM _tool_codecov_repo_configs rc WHERE rc.repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
)
SELECT repo_id, patch_target FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY repo_id

queries.label: last_pipeline
queries.sql_text:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(finished_at)) * 1000 AS lastupdate
FROM _devlake_pipelines
WHERE :has_blueprint = 1 AND blueprint_id IN (:blueprint_ids)
  AND status IN ('TASK_COMPLETED', 'TASK_PARTIAL')
